causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Very high temperatures in Melbourne and Adelaide led to high demand in both regions.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand for electricity across the combined region was up to 320 MW higher than forecast.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Total semi-scheduled wind generation across Victoria and South Australia was between 39 MW and 331 MW lower than forecast four hours ahead.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Energy Australia advised AEMO that it would be taking its 355 MW Yallourn unit 4 out of service for planned maintenance from 19 January for a period of seven days.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: AGL's Loy Yang A unit 3 experienced a tube leak removing a further 530 MW of potential available capacity in Victoria from the afternoon of 22 January to 26 January.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: As a result, special pricing arrangements were put in place setting the spot price for electricity in Victoria at or near the market price cap for several trading intervals.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood
interconnectors_named.quote: Victoria is connected to South Australia via two interconnectors - Heywood and Murraylink, while Victoria is connected to New South Wales via the Victoria - New South Wales (Vic - NSW) interconnector, and to Tasmania via Basslink.

interconnectors_named.quote: Victoria is connected to South Australia via two interconnectors - Heywood and Murraylink, while Victoria is connected to New South Wales via the Victoria - New South Wales (Vic - NSW) interconnector, and to Tasmania via Basslink.

interconnectors_named.quote: Victoria is connected to South Australia via two interconnectors - Heywood and Murraylink, while Victoria is connected to New South Wales via the Victoria - New South Wales (Vic - NSW) interconnector, and to Tasmania via Basslink.

intervals.quote: On 24 January 2019, the spot price for electricity exceeded $5000/MWh over 11 trading intervals from 4 pm to 9 pm inclusive in Victoria and South Australia.

peak_price.quote: The spot price reached the market price cap (MPC) of $14 500/MWh in Victoria at 6.30 pm and 7 pm and in South Australia from 5.30 pm to 8.30 pm.

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding into high price bands did not contribute to the high prices in Victoria and South Australia.
